feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 17 November 2026 10:00pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 17 November 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the west of Ireland and another in the North Sea as a slow-moving and complex frontal zone affects the British Isles.


##Wind##

East or southeasterly 4 to 6 in the north and east of the area, whereas west or southwesterly 2 to 4 in the south and west of the area.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or showers.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or northeasterly 4 to 6 in the north and east of the area, whereas variable 2 to 4 in the south and west of the area. Becoming east or northeast 5 or 6 in all waters later Thursday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or showers gradually clearing towards the south later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.
